regions.label: The Old Iron Stairs
regions.observation: The iron stairs lead down from the quay to the river stones. This is the route to the reported recovery site.

regions.label: The Recovery Site
regions.observation: The stones below the old iron stairs. Lillian's coat has already been taken into police custody; examining the site is not examining the garment.

area.arrivalHint: Click the Riverside Rooms door to open it, then click the opening to enter.
